title: American Pole & Timber Reviews The Importance of Involvement in Industry Associations
text:
American Pole & Timber's participation in these esteemed organizations reflects their dedication to excellence in the construction, marine, and specialty timber industries. Feb 27, 2025 - Houston, TX - American Pole & Timber is a company that takes pride in being an active part of the industries they serve. Their memberships in leading industry organizations demonstrate their commitment to quality, innovation, and staying at the forefront of advancements in construction, marine, and specialty wood markets. These affiliations help them stay informed about industry trends, best practices, and emerging technologies while also reinforcing their dedication to building strong relationships within the sectors they serve.
These are some of the industry and/or trade organizations with which they are involved.
Association of Zoos & Aquariums (AZA)
Association of Zoos & Aquariums The AZA is dedicated to advancing animal welfare, conservation, education, and science. As a supplier of large and specialty timber products, American Pole & Timber supports the needs of zoos and aquariums, providing durable and environmentally friendly materials for exhibits, enclosures, and facilities that prioritize animal safety and sustainability.
Greater Houston Builders Association (GHBA)
Greater Houston Builders Association GHBA represents Houston’s residential construction industry, advocating for building professionals, suppliers, and industry partners. Our involvement in GHBA keeps us connected with builders, architects, and engineers, ensuring we provide high-quality, reliable construction materials that meet the needs of residential and commercial projects throughout the region in which we are headquartered.
Marina Association of Texas
Marina Association of Texas The Marina Association of Texas is a wonderful organization committed to promoting and supporting the marina and waterfront industry. Our membership allows us to stay informed about industry regulations, best practices, and the latest innovations in marine construction, ensuring that we continue to provide superior products for docks, piers, and other waterfront structures.
Wood Truss Council
Wood Truss Council The Wood Truss Council is focused on advancing the use of wood trusses and structural building components. As a provider of engineered wood products, including timber trusses, we align with the council’s mission to promote safe, efficient, and sustainable building solutions that optimize the use of timber in structural applications.
Pile Driving Contractors Association (PDCA)
Pile Driving Contractors Association PDCA represents pile driving contractors, equipment manufacturers, and material suppliers, advocating for the driven pile industry. Our membership reinforces our expertise in supplying high-quality timber piles and foundational materials for heavy construction and infrastructure projects.
Commitment to The Industry Communities
American Pole & Timber's participation in these esteemed organizations reflects their dedication to excellence in the construction, marine, and specialty timber industries. Staying engaged with these professional groups helps ensure that they stay abreast of industry advancements, support the professionals and businesses that rely on their materials, and are aware of the latest innovations related to materials, construction practices, and quality control methods.
American Pole & Timber is proud to be a trusted partner across multiple industries. Whether it’s supplying durable wood for marine construction, supporting conservation efforts at zoos and aquariums, or contributing to Houston’s growing residential market, the company remains committed to delivering the best solutions for their clients' projects.
For more information about the company and their products, please contact them at AmericanPoleAndTimber.com .
